title: Kenyan Beef Wrap
description: A fusion of Kenyan and French flavors in a tender beef wrap. The beef is marinated in a mix of spices and cooked to perfection, then wrapped in a deliciously flavored tortilla with vegetables.

ingredients.name: Beef strips
ingredients.notes: Slice the beef into thin strips

instructions: Marinate the beef strips in a mixture of chili flakes, cumin powder, salt, and black pepper for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the beef strips until browned and cooked through.
In the same pan, add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the beef and onion mixture onto each tortilla, followed by lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
